fit_qa.base: hm08 reference base (work/leg_R.obj scored against it; hm08 landmarks in work/hm08_landmarks.json)
fit_qa.note: The 'poor' verdict is the inset-patch rubric applied to a whole-leg replacement: the part only engages the base at the hip skirt seat, and 25.08% of its verts sit outside the plantigrade base's scoring grid because the digitigrade chain departs from the hm08 leg envelope by design. buried 0.0 / excess 0.0 are the applicable gates — see DIGITIGRADE.md s.6.
fit_qa.verdict: partial (ships with notes, per PARTS_STANDARD s.5 pattern)

label: Digitigrade leg (right)

provenance.detail: Procedural loft construction (scripts/build_digitigrade.py): 19-station elliptical loft (thigh/shin/metatarsus/paw) + 4 toe mini-lofts + main pad, 4 toe pads, 4 claw cones; joint positions and proportions measured from the hm08 reference base; segment split and standing angles from canine structure data cited in DIGITIGRADE.md.

qa_gauntlet.contract: 4/36 core joints (Hip_R, Knee_R, Ankle_R, Foot_R) + 1 module joint (Hock_R, the digitigrade hock module of socket leg.digi.R) — module parts are exempt from the full-character contract gate
qa_gauntlet.degenerate_tris_note: all 104 are UV-sphere pole fans in the paw pads (main pad 24, toe pads 80) — zero-area pole triangles, render-harmless, fail the gauntlet geometry gate; fix is collapsing each pole ring to one vertex

socket_note: Scope divergence flagged in DIGITIGRADE.md s.5: PARTS_STANDARD socket 16 scopes leg.digi as a lower-leg/paw module (~0.28 m, anchored at Ankle_R + hock module, plantigrade thigh kept). This part is a FULL leg from the hip (0.898 m extent, own Hip_R root, pelvis skirt) — it implements the digitigrade chain end-to-end rather than swapping below a plantigrade thigh. Either the socket grows a full-leg variant or the thigh section is reference geometry for a future lower-leg-only cut.
